name: Cedarville University
academic_ranking: Private Baptist Christian university (est. 1887) in Cedarville, OH, accredited by the Higher Learning Commission. Enrollment ~6,384 total (~4,024 undergraduates). Offers 150+ programs of study. Recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the top three evangelical Christian universities in the U.S. All students complete a 15-credit-hour Bible minor and attend chapel.
financial_aid: Academic scholarships for new residential freshmen range from $15,000 to $25,000 per year, renewable up to four years with GPA requirements maintained. Also offers need-based scholarships and grants, academic program scholarships (e.g., music, pharmacy), athletic scholarships, and federal student loans via FAFSA. Recently all new residential freshmen received aid, with average awards exceeding $26,800. Source: cedarville.edu/cost, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Yellow Jackets softball competes at the NCAA Division II level. 441-acre rural campus; ~80% of students live on campus. Specific softball facility details not confirmed on the live athletics site as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC); Cedarville is also a member of the National Christian College Athletic Association (NCCAA). Team nickname: Yellow Jackets.
notes: Coaching staff and roster confirmed live from yellowjackets.cedarville.edu softball pages on 2026-07. Staff directory listed only a head coach and one assistant coach; no recruiting coordinator, volunteer, graduate assistant, or director of player development listed. No individual Twitter/X handles listed for coaches. Exact annual tuition not retrievable from an authoritative live source at research time, so left null to avoid guessing.
